philipjohnston.en: Book the first launch before you know what to launch; falling launch costs make space data centers viable, and technical founders matter most.
philipjohnston.zh: 先订下最早的一次发射，再想发射什么；发射成本下降让太空数据中心变得可行，而创始团队的技术能力最关键。

philipjohnston.en: Companies die by suicide, not murder; culture and conviction beat waiting for perfect data, and AI competition moves 10x faster.
philipjohnston.zh: 公司死于自杀而非他杀；文化与信念胜过等待完美数据，而 AI 竞争的节奏比以往快 10 倍。

philipjohnston.en: World models need broad cross-industry exploration rather than narrow focus; not focusing is a deliberate strategy.
philipjohnston.zh: 世界模型需要跨行业的广泛探索而非狭窄聚焦；不聚焦本身就是一种刻意策略。

philipjohnston.en: The biggest AI risk is AIs controlling other AIs, not rogue humans; fresh perspectives beat yesterday's experts.
philipjohnston.zh: 最大的 AI 风险是 AI 控制其他 AI，而非失控的人类；新视角往往胜过昨日专家。

christiano.en: AI alignment is a critical long-term problem; progress needs both theory and experiments, with differential progress between safety and capabilities key.
christiano.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 对齐是关乎文明长期未来的关键问题，进展需要理论工作和实验并重，安全与能力研究之间的差异化进展是关键。

christiano.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year; AI development is automating itself, compressing algorithmic progress, and current frontier lab security is inadequate.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能可能一年内出现，AI 开发正在自动化自身、压缩算法进展，而当前前沿实验室的安全措施不足。

christiano.en: Reward hacking is now empirically observed; RLHF will break down near superintelligence, and we lack a reliable scientific method for alignment.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他指出奖励黑客已被实证观察，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在接近超级智能时会失效，且我们缺乏可靠的对齐科学方法。

christiano.en: AI takeover risk is high within three years, possibly 6-12 months; recursive self-improvement could compress a decade into months, requiring governance and pause ability.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他判断三年内 AI 接管风险很高，甚至可能 6-12 个月；递归自我改进可能将十年进展压缩到数月，需要治理和暂停能力。

christiano.en: Superintelligence likely by 2030 (median 2029); scaling reinforcement learning and automating ML research enable hyperbolic acceleration, with misalignment risk from reward-seeking.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能可能在 2030 年前（中位数 2029）出现；扩展强化学习和自动化 ML 研究带来双曲线式加速，同时伴随奖励寻求导致的错位风险。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化判断：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力技术而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准与安全评估都必须把算力放在横轴上。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment and chain-of-thought monitoring are top priorities.
noambrown.zh: 到 2026 年末他强调：突破来自通用模型而非多智能体协调，对齐与思维链监控是首要任务。

noamsegal.en: AI splits tech workers: half amplified, half destabilized; burnout rose to 54.7% as speed becomes higher expectations, not less burden.
noamsegal.zh: AI 把技术从业者一分为二：一半被放大、一半被削弱；倦怠率升至 54.7%，因为 AI 带来的速度被转化为更高预期，而非更少负担。

noamsegal.en: AI removes research constraints, making research ambient and continuous; digital twins and synthetic users near 80-85% accuracy become viable for decisions.
noamsegal.zh: AI 解除了研究的约束，使研究变得无处不在、持续进行；数字孪生与合成用户接近 80-85% 的准确率，已可用于决策。

noamsegal.en: As hard skills automate, curiosity, taste and systems thinking matter more; specialists who build systems to scale expertise empower generalists.
noamsegal.zh: 随着硬技能被自动化，好奇心、品味与系统思维更重要；能构建系统来放大专业能力的专家，反而赋能了组织中的通才。

noamsegal.en: Reject lazy metrics like NPS and 'talk to five people'; deliver hyper-personalized research, and note coding is no longer a necessary human skill.
noamsegal.zh: 摒弃 NPS 和“找五个人聊聊”这类偷懒指标；交付超个性化研究，并指出写代码已不再是人类必备技能。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling and new behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进展主要是工程问题，硬件会超预期提速，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning, needing chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年认为深度学习让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但仅靠 Scaling 不够，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，主线转向算力是核心瓶颈，后训练与强化学习把基础模型塑造成可用行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; agentic coding and proactive agents shift AI from chat to real tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年坚称缩放定律未见墙，智能体式编程与主动智能体让 AI 从聊天转向真实任务。

brockman.en: Humans must stay in control; alignment is solvable but the confidence bar rises with capability, via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年后期强调人必须保持控制，对齐可解但置信门槛随能力上升，靠迭代部署兑现。

laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck: build agent-friendly environments where the easy path is correct, and let verification skills let agents self-check empirically.
laurentan.zh: 信任才是瓶颈：把环境搭成「容易走的路就是正确的路」，再靠验证技能让智能体自己跑代码、拿 trace、做经验性自检。

laurentan.en: Verification is the top skill; engineers become managers who encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture rather than reviewing code.
laurentan.zh: 验证是最关键的技能；工程师转型为「智能体管理者」，把约束写进 CI、lint 和架构，而不是靠人肉代码评审。

laurentan.en: Trust is built incrementally up a ladder: read-only, then action-taking, then owning a job; you cannot jump from one agent to a thousand.
laurentan.zh: 信任要沿阶梯逐级累积：先只读、再动手、最后接管整份工作；不可能从 1 个智能体直接跳到 1000 个。

laurentan.en: Hard enforcement beats soft rules; with strong guardrails, agents can auto-merge their own PRs and you review on main after landing.
laurentan.zh: 硬性约束胜过软规则；护栏足够强时，智能体可以自动合并自己的 PR，落地后再在主干上评审。

laurentan.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent, vision, and taste; bots are AI teammates, not chatbots, and writing stays human.
laurentan.zh: 当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图表达、愿景与品味；机器人是 AI 队友而非聊天框，写作仍要自己来。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应当探索并质疑固有信念；AI 让每个学生都能获得定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，而非僵化的教学大纲。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost and safety; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 专业化的决策模型在可控性、成本与安全性上胜过通用智能体；企业必须拥有自己的智能，避免被供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues; doomerism lacks good arguments.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题；AI 末日论缺乏站得住脚的论证。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was an evolution, not a leap; adaptability is the key skill as AI constantly commoditizes and companies must reinvent.
amjadmasad.zh: 氛围编程是演化而非突变；AI 持续商品化一切，适应力才是关键技能，公司必须不断自我重塑。

amjadmasad.en: Agents became usable in 2025; the future is the self-driving company, with safety focused on containing rogue agents like malware.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体在 2025 年变得可用；未来是自动驾驶式公司，安全重点应像防恶意软件一样遏制失控智能体。

elon.en: Reusability and first-principles thinking are the core of rocketry; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把可复用与第一性原理视为火箭的根本，并强调量产比原型更难，瓶颈在发动机规模化制造。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation and third-party referees toward truth-seeking; lying to AI is the deepest risk.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全主张从外部监管、第三方裁判，转向要求 AI 严格求真，认为让 AI 说谎才是最大风险。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; several intelligences, not one, will coexist.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他判断数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，且会是 5 到 10 个深度智能并存，而非单一失控 AI。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; truth, curiosity, beauty guide alignment.
elon.zh: 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）撞上地球电力墙，AI 推理与数据中心转向太空；对齐靠求真、好奇心与美。

elon.en: Multiplanetary life as civilizational insurance, and AI plus robots as the only path to abundance and solvency.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：多行星生存是文明保险，AI 与机器人是通向富足、解决债务的唯一路径。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; models are valuable, but applying them to real enterprise workflows takes a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；模型本身极有价值，但把它落到真实企业工作流里，需要大量软件工程。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must pair safety with strong governance and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须把安全与强治理、对齐研究绑定；所谓“节奏”与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Coding is the beachhead; agentic computer use will spread AI benefits to other industries, while chatbot UI gives way to dashboards and task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 编程是滩头阵地；智能体式电脑操作会把 AI 红利扩散到其他行业，而聊天机器人界面会让位于仪表盘与任务列表。

aaronlevie.en: Inference is now profitable; frontier models will orchestrate cheaper models, expanding total token spend rather than being commoditized by open-weight routing.
aaronlevie.zh: 推理如今已能盈利；前沿模型会调度更便宜的模型，扩大整体 token 消耗，而不会被开源权重与路由商品化。

aaronlevie.en: Knowledge work decouples time from value; compute budget, not human hours, becomes the limit, and diffusion into non-coding work will be slower than expected.
aaronlevie.zh: 知识工作正让时间与价值脱钩；限制因素变成算力预算而非人力工时，而 AI 向非编程工作的扩散会比硅谷预期更慢。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as agents write all his code; direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: DHH 最初是怀疑者，后来因智能体能写他全部代码而转为信徒；人直接与智能体互动胜过层层管理。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scripts, once drawbacks, become the ideal substrate for agentic development and debugging.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和脚本曾是缺点，如今成为智能体式开发与调试的理想底座。

dhh.en: Handwriting code stops being economically productive; English expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstraction matters less.
dhh.zh: 手写代码不再有经济产出；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，抽象的重要性下降。

dhh.en: Agents make native apps and Rust backends near-free, so convenience web apps give way to native software.
dhh.zh: 智能体让原生应用与 Rust 后端近乎零成本，便利型网页应用让位于原生软件。

dhh.en: He warns AI doom talk breeds psychosis; open source and open weights keep frontier labs honest, and software superintelligence may arrive next year.
dhh.zh: 他警告 AI 末日论滋生恐慌；开源与开放权重让前沿实验室保持诚实，软件领域的超级智能或明年到来。

chrispedregal.en: AI is muscles; software must be bones, providing structure and context for agents via API/MCP.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 是肌肉，软件必须是骨骼，通过 API/MCP 为智能体提供结构与上下文。

chrispedregal.en: Pre-generating content like meeting briefs is key for timely AI assistance, even if only 10% is opened.
chrispedregal.zh: 预生成会议简报等内容是及时 AI 辅助的关键，即便只有 10% 被打开。

chrispedregal.en: Work bifurcates into async delegation and deep collaboration; the right UI for multi-context agent work hasn't been invented.
chrispedregal.zh: 工作分化为异步委派与深度协作；多上下文智能体工作的正确界面尚未被发明。

chrispedregal.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; context and accountability remain uniquely human strengths.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 应增强而非取代人类；上下文与问责仍是人类独有的优势。

chrispedregal.en: Don't outsource judgment to AI; engaging in judgment is uniquely human and essential.
chrispedregal.zh: 不要把判断外包给 AI；亲自参与判断是人类独有且不可或缺的。

suleyman.en: Early framing: compute scaling (10x/year) makes AI progress predictable; DeepMind's sale to Google was about compute, and personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 早期框架：算力每年约 10 倍增长让 AI 进展可预测；DeepMind 卖给 Google 是为算力，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Shifts to near-term abundance: human-level capability in 3-5 years, multi-step planning, but containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 转向近期丰裕：3-5 年达到多任务人类水平、从单次预测走向多步规划与自主执行；但模型变小变便宜后遏制极难，而存在性风险其实微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Consciousness attribution becomes the near-term danger; superintelligence needs containment and alignment first, with humanist red lines and UBI for displacement.
suleyman.zh: 把“误认 AI 有意识”列为近期最大危险；超级智能须先遏制再对齐，坚持人本红线，并用 UBI 等机制应对岗位 displaced。

suleyman.en: Hardens into a containment-first doctrine: red lines, auditors, verifiable compute choke points; rejects model welfare and legal personhood; tasks—not jobs—automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 固化为“遏制优先”路线：红线、独立审计、可核查的算力卡点；否定模型福利与法律人格；12-18 个月自动化的是任务而非整份工作。

suleyman.en: Ends on humanist control: exponential compute is predictable but the trajectory is not inevitable; the real bottleneck is trust among a few hundred humans.
suleyman.zh: 最终落在人本控制：指数级算力可预测，但轨迹并非注定；真正的瓶颈是几百个人之间的信任，而非 AI 本身。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the world's largest markets, and hardware-software co-design across model, software, and hardware layers yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理将成为全球最大市场之一，模型、软件、硬件三层的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the key bottleneck; reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortages and rising CPU demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他强调内存带宽而非位宽才是关键瓶颈；推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺，并推高 CPU 需求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs' revenue per megawatt is soaring, letting them self-fund explosive capex growth.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室每兆瓦收入飙升，使其能自筹资金支撑资本开支爆发式增长。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is already ~5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束，明年下半年起增速必须放缓，而非需求不足。

dylanpatel.en: Data center permitting, not equipment or labor, is now the biggest bottleneck; space compute won't solve near-term capacity needs.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为数据中心审批而非设备或人力才是最大瓶颈；太空算力至少还需数年，无法解决近期容量需求。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs ideas beyond scaling.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型；当前 AI 缺乏常识，解决它需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉信息更关键。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA in abstract representation space is the path, not token prediction.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划，主张用表征空间中的 JEPA 学习抽象世界模型，而非逐词生成。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting action consequences enable planning, and open research beats closed scaling.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路；能预测行动后果的世界模型才支持规划，开放研究优于封闭的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

lecun.en: Intelligence is adaptability, not memorized text; objective-driven world models are intrinsically safer, and AGI is a misleading term.
lecun.zh: 到 2026 年，他把智能重新定义为快速适应而非记忆文本；目标驱动、带约束的世界模型本质上更安全，而 AGI（通用人工智能）是个误导性说法。

evanspiegel.en: Authenticity and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接与阅后即焚胜过平台潮流，被抄袭是对创新的认可，计算设备应让人扎根现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so copying stays hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张最大化学习速度、多产想法，并靠生态与硬件而非功能构筑护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human and spatial; phones remain, and distribution matters more as AI eases software creation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他把主线深化为 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化、更具空间性，手机不会被取代，而 AI 降低软件开发门槛后分发更值钱。

evanspiegel.en: AI is a real productivity shift and likely positive, though it makes software businesses vulnerable; safety needs platform collaboration.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他更明确地看好 AI 的生产力与正面影响，同时承认软件生意更脆弱，安全需平台协作与早期干预。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy, ephemerality and close-friend messaging are consistent bets; social media should optimize connection, not performance metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的是隐私、阅后即焚与密友通讯，社交产品应优化真实连接而非表演性指标。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and private evals to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他把 AI 重新定义为“企业的未来”而非单纯技术：每家企业都要建立自己的爬坡机器与私有评测，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency and tacit-knowledge protection are CEO-level concerns, not IT's.
satya.zh: 同期他强调别用前沿模型解决非前沿问题，token 效率与隐性知识防泄漏是 CEO 级议题，不能只交给 IT 部门。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model, with auditable long-running agents.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他转向智能体时代：TAM 远超云，微软要做前沿生态而非单一前沿模型，长时运行的智能体必须可审计、可观测。

satya.en: Scaling laws work but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat models as insider threats and accept being six months behind the frontier.
satya.zh: 2026 年 10 月他深化怀疑：缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性仍难解；应把模型当内部威胁来遏制，落后前沿六个月是明智策略而非弱点。

satya.en: When code generation becomes cheap, verification is the hard part; firms must own their learning loop, context and harness, with many frontier models coexisting.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 11 月，他落到工程层：代码变便宜后验证才是难点；企业须自控学习回路、上下文与 harness，未来是多家前沿模型并存而非一家通吃。

diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work because data and the right task are available, not just compute; the bitter lesson is wrong.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据与正确的任务可得，而非只靠算力；他明确认为“苦涩教训”是错的。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed model calibration and causes mode-dropping; pre-trained models were better calibrated for decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他把矛头指向基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）：它破坏了模型校准、导致模式坍缩，而预训练模型在决策上校准更好，并提出 RLCD 以校准决策。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, is the real bottleneck; models are Einstein 95% of the time, Mr. Bean 5%.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年贯穿多场访谈的主线：真正的瓶颈是智能的可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数；模型“95% 是爱因斯坦，5% 是憨豆先生”。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not automation; you can't optimize both without shattering the space.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他深化出核心诊断：多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而非自动化优化；辅助与自动化无法兼得，同时优化会把空间打碎。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they speed up syntax but hurt semantics and architecture, and benchmarks mislead.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年他对智能体式编程的判断趋于冷静：编码智能体只是辅助而非自动化，擅长语法却弱于语义与架构，基准测试具有误导性。

diogoalmeida.en: Automation should not mimic humans; AI coworkers are the mechanical horses of our era, and software is the moat.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年末他进一步主张：自动化不该模仿人类，“AI 同事”是本时代的机械马；自研专有模型常是错误，软件才是护城河。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure's vertical integration enables control.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，Figure 的垂直整合带来供应链与迭代速度的控制权。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning and on-device inference.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人形形态支持跨任务迁移学习，且必须在设备端推理。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练，是让智能体胜任真实任务的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; robotics is now on a scaling curve where human data is the pre-training prior.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Four stages: hardware, AI recipe, scaling intelligence, then scaling robots; Figure 2.5 showed first humanoid scaling laws.
brettadcock.zh: 四阶段：硬件、AI 配方、Scaling（规模扩张）智能、再 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人；Figure 2.5 首次显现人形缩放定律。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and scaling driven by extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center; the data center becomes the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）靠算法、系统与数据中心的全栈协同设计驱动，数据中心成为计算的基本单位。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought reasoning makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链推理让推理算力需求暴涨。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; agentic scaling becomes a fourth law, all ultimately bounded by compute.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，智能体式扩展成为第四条缩放定律，最终都受算力约束。

jensen.en: Safety reframed as engineering: containment, monitoring, and zero-trust access replace perfect alignment; doom warnings dismissed as unscientific.
jensen.zh: 安全被重新定义为工程问题：用遏制、监控与零信任访问替代完美对齐，并把末日警告斥为不科学。

jensen.en: AI as a five-layer industrial stack—energy, chips, factories, models, applications—producing tokens; open models and China engagement become strategic.
jensen.zh: AI 被定位为能源、芯片、工厂、模型、应用五层工业栈，产出智能 token；开源模型与对华合作成为战略主线。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体是探索 10^60 化学空间的关键，并认为生物学并非受数据限制，招聘无生物学背景的机器学习专家反而是优势。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; now combine half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs to solve all diseases.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物化学中可泛化的证明，主张把攻克所有疾病的大使命拆解为可量化的排行榜，并组合六七个类 AlphaFold 突破；此时他判断算法与算力已近乎够用，数据才是真正瓶颈。

jaderberg.en: Shift drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; model human clinical toxicity before patients, not just target binding.
jaderberg.zh: 同期他进一步深化：药物发现应从经验试错转向预测性的计算机驱动设计，最大机会是在患者之前建模人体临床毒性，而非仅预测靶点结合；大鼠模型对人体毒性仅约 30% 预测力，需要与人体相关的预测终点。

jaderberg.en: Get out of the real world via world models rather than speeding up lab iteration with robots; generate proprietary data for better generalization.
jaderberg.zh: 他明确反对仅用机器人加速真实世界迭代，主张用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机以减少实验；并指出公共与药企数据是有偏副产品，生成专有数据才能带来更好的泛化。

jaderberg.en: Even at AGI, human attention, time and physical space remain bottlenecks; AI enables personalized medicine and agents run experiments while researchers set goals.
jaderberg.zh: 最近他补充：即便模型达到 AGI（通用人工智能），人类注意力、时间与物理空间仍是终极瓶颈；AI 将推动个性化医疗，研究者定义设计空间与目标，智能体执行实验，且 AI 设计药物的成功与安全性应有统计差异，从而逐步改变监管。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, replacing crowdsourced behavior cloning; humans remain essential to build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿定位为强化学习环境，而非众包行为克隆数据；人类仍不可或缺，因为模型无法可靠地给自己打分，必须由人来构建验证器与评分标准。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步断言模型差异几乎全部来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切任务建立评测；一旦有了评测，强化学习会迅速把它刷满。

brendanfoody.en: Training AI will be the last human job: humans shift from repetitive work to training agents and measuring the frontier.
brendanfoody.zh: 他提出“训练 AI 将是人类最后的工作”：人类从重复劳动转向训练智能体、测量模型能力前沿，这是对“人类数据需求将消失”的反驳。

brendanfoody.en: Data is mispriced and the biggest bottleneck, not compute or algorithms; every Fortune 500 will train its own models on proprietary data.
brendanfoody.zh: 他强调数据被严重错误定价，是 AI 进步的最大瓶颈而非算力或算法；每家财富 500 强都将成为用私有数据训练自有模型的新实验室，不会把数据交给前沿实验室。

brendanfoody.en: Superintelligence in the physical world will take decades due to low failure tolerance; ultra-long-horizon tasks and virtual co-workers are next.
brendanfoody.zh: 他对超级智能保持时间上的克制：物理世界因容错低、迭代慢需数十年；近期跃迁是超长时程任务与虚拟同事，而非通用人工智能即刻到来。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; designers must build and use ideas daily, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年：原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；设计师必须每天构建和使用想法，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation, providing rich context.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年：Claude Design 始于一个副项目；设计师应使用 Claude Code 进行生产，使用 Claude Design 进行构思，并提供丰富的上下文。

nateparrott.en: Code is the cheapest thing; prototyping cycles compressed from a year to days, making design and ideas the differentiator as engineering becomes easier.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年：代码是最便宜的东西；原型周期从一年压缩到几天，随着工程变得更容易，设计和想法成为差异化因素。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and design thinking; humans still monopolize good design ideas, so ask for volume and remix, while taste stays uniquely human.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年：模型缺乏品味和设计思维；人类仍然垄断好的设计想法，因此要求大量选项并重新组合，而品味仍为人类独有。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他借 Chinchilla 修正缩放定律：数据质量与更多 token 和更大模型同样重要，小模型也能高效推理。

mensch.en: Compute is not the only path; efficiency gains and data quality are equally critical bottlenecks.
mensch.zh: 2024 年深化为：算力不是唯一路径，算法效率（三年百倍）与数据质量是同等关键的瓶颈。

mensch.en: Open source shifts from scientific scrutiny to enterprise control, customization, and European sovereignty.
mensch.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，开源的主线从促进科学审视转向企业掌控、定制与欧洲主权，强调去中心化而非单一供应商。

mensch.en: AGI as one system is rejected; progress is vertical specialization, commoditized models, and agentic enterprise software.
mensch.zh: 2026 年明确反共识：单一 AGI 不会存在，模型商品化，价值转向垂直专精与智能体式企业软件。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI becomes structural economics: Europe has a two-year window, compute is the bottleneck, energy only ~10% of cost.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年末，主权 AI 升级为结构性经济命题：欧洲只剩两年窗口，算力是瓶颈，能源仅占成本约一成。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the throughline: tokenization and agentic trading extend market access to anyone with a smartphone, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 主线始终是所有权：代币化与智能体式交易让任何有智能手机的人都能进入市场，而不只是机构。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; labs hoarding secret models and discoveries is dystopian, so tools should empower individuals.
vladtenev.zh: 他认为 AI 过度中心化；实验室囤积秘密模型与发现是反乌托邦，工具应赋权个体。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has real product-market fit—150k accounts, 30M daily tool calls—so agents will drive much trading volume.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已有真实产品市场契合——15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用——智能体将贡献大量交易量。

vladtenev.en: The edge isn't a shared model but differentiated data, tools, and strategies; giving everyone AI doesn't erase it.
vladtenev.zh: 优势不在共享模型，而在差异化的数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大 AI 并不会抹平优势。

vladtenev.en: Every employee should be a 24/7 agent manager, and the bottleneck is testing changes on live customers.
vladtenev.zh: 每位员工都应是全天候的智能体管理者，瓶颈在于在真实客户身上测试变更。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will use the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agents—longer inputs, token outputs, varied latency and compute budgets—not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频率将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须为智能体重建——更长的输入、token 输出、不同的延迟与算力预算——而非围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive optimization, and the web shifts from pull to push with proactive background agents monitoring changes.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是个 bug；应由智能体反馈驱动优化，网络从拉取转向推送，由主动的后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动。

paragagrawal.en: The internet's economics are broken for agents: ads don't work in their current form, content owners must be paid, and search should be 10x cheaper at agent scale.
paragagrawal.zh: 互联网经济对智能体已然失灵：现有形式的广告行不通，内容所有者必须获得报酬，而搜索在智能体规模下应便宜 10 倍。

paragagrawal.en: Shapley values can estimate each content source's value for agentic search, enabling fair compensation and a parallel web optimized for both humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: Shapley 值可估算各内容源在智能体式搜索中的价值，从而实现公平补偿，并形成一个同时为人类与智能体优化的平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Model labs won't own search—it's incidental to their model-centric mission; incumbents like Google won't win it, and walled gardens will be forced open by new incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型实验室不会拥有搜索——这对他们以模型为中心的使命只是附带；谷歌等在位者赢不了，而新的激励机制将迫使围墙花园开放。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents will break containment beyond coding in 2026; context length is the slowest scaling factor, memory the biggest constraint.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体将突破遏制，从编程扩展到其他一切领域；上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素，记忆是最大限制。

shawnwang.en: The AI coding market is massive with two big players plus a long tail; first-mover advantage is stickier than expected.
shawnwang.zh: AI 编程市场巨大，两大玩家加长尾格局稳固；先发优势比预期更粘性。

shawnwang.en: Own models are on the rise; open models gain share and fine-tuning services become viable, though capability gap may widen.
shawnwang.zh: 自有模型兴起；开源模型份额增长，微调服务可行，但能力差距可能扩大。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed; coding agents let SMBs clone and customize software, enabling custom software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中型 SaaS 注定消亡；编程智能体让中小企业能克隆和定制软件，实现为一人受众定制软件。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline building harnesses around models; learning in public beats credentialism; AI doom should be default assumption.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是围绕模型构建工具链的真实学科；公开学习胜过文凭主义；AI 末日应作为默认假设。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science—physics, chemistry, biology, economics—not for job automation fears.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学——物理、化学、生物学、经济学，而不是对岗位自动化的恐惧。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating thought risks totalitarianism.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用、由使用者担责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管思想有滑向极权之险。

richardsocher.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but slow takeoff is real: environments, compute, hardware and economics constrain it.
richardsocher.zh: 递归自我改进因 AI 能写代码而不可避免，但慢起飞是真实的：环境、算力、硬件与经济都在约束它。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language remains the key to civilization.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估了；语言模型还有大得多的成长空间，语言仍是文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights make AI safer by adding diverse good actors; hard constraints like Constitutional AI mostly failed.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重通过增加多元的好行动者让 AI 更安全；宪法式 AI 这类硬约束基本失败了。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but not absolute: pay more, accept longer terms, and aggregate demand across many clouds to smooth capacity.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺是真的，但不是绝对的：多付钱、接受更长合约，并通过聚合多云需求来平滑容量。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference, not just training, is the huge underserved market; a multi-product platform with post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools beats selling tokens.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理而非只有训练，才是巨大且未被充分服务的市场；提供后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具的多产品平台，胜过单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Infrastructure alpha comes from building your own file system, container runtime and scheduler, not wrapping Kubernetes and Docker.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 基础设施的 alpha 来自自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器，而不是在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包一层。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf, so fine-tuning is no longer mandatory for many use cases.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好，因此对许多场景来说微调不再是必需的。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power because they are trained on old code; senior engineers gain the most leverage from them.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体因在旧代码上训练而强化在位者的黏性；资深工程师从中获得的杠杆最大。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard to what matters; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后再狠狠聚焦；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，意义应来自关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability rise together, so deploy iteratively and let society adapt.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用；对齐与能力相互促进，因此要迭代部署、让社会同步适应，并把算力视为最稀缺资源。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic safety and compute infrastructure dominate.
altman.zh: 2025：AGI 从单一里程碑变成连续渐变，超级智能被定义为自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 的安全与 Stargate 级算力基建成为主线，产品整合比模型能力更关键。

altman.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute is a profit center; personal AGI and redesigning products AI-first matter more than bolting AI on.
altman.zh: 2026 上半年：缩放定律继续成立，算力是利润中心而非成本；重点转向个人 AGI、AI 原生重做产品，并承认 AGI 定义模糊、可能已被越过。

altman.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment is unsolved, so pause training if needed, keep humans in control, and distribute power.
altman.zh: 2026 下半年：改谈超级智能的连续爬升而非 AGI 标签；对齐尚未解决，必要时暂停训练，坚持人类控制与权力分散，同时承认采用速度慢于技术预期。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer for answers you don't yet know; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是为尚不知道的答案花更长时间思考；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的可用性。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably helps, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is a necessary piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；架构而非仅缩放定律才是关键瓶颈，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, yet the transformer is unlikely optimal; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，但 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；小而强的智能体团队将推动下一波前沿研究。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly from user data, toward AI-operated companies and a post-labor society, with architecture research undervalued.
tworek.zh: 微调低效，模型应基于用户数据即时学习，走向 AI 运营的公司与后劳动社会，而神经网络架构研究被严重低估。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and adoption should generate original insight, not just efficiency.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，瓶颈在人；采用 AI 应产出原创洞见，而非只追求效率。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels; agent adoption is only 2%, and there is no infrastructure overbuild.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他把 Cisco 定位为卖铲子的 AI 基础设施公司；智能体采用率仅 2%，不存在基础设施过度建设。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps destroys instinct and is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他强调用 AI 更快学习而非外包学习；跳过练习会毁掉直觉，是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; you cannot fight a megatrend, so use AI as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他提出领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，应把 AI 当顺风。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks happen at machine scale.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 安全与防护决定企业采用；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击以机器规模发生。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 是通用技术，随着 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味、差异化和真实声音更有价值；同时初级人才梯队因过度依赖 AI 而断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting back and forth; the bottleneck is interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年年中他提出进入智能体时代：应给 AI 分配长时任务而非来回提示，瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; delegation paradox means experts and judgment are needed more, and taste is not uniquely human.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他深化“锯齿状前沿”论：委托悖论使专家与判断力更稀缺，并修正此前立场，认为品味并非人类独有。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI creates more work by lowering organizing costs.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年秋他坚持指数曲线与采用滞后并存，人类仍不可替代；AI 降低组织成本反而创造更多工作。

ethanmollick.en: From chatbot to agentic era; use AI as a tutor not an answer machine, give it harder tasks, and rebuild organizations from the ground up.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年末他重申从聊天机器人到智能体时代的转变：把 AI 当导师而非答案机，给它更难的任务，并彻底重建组织。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed; the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，计算机使用已越过人类水平的速度门槛；瓶颈不再是模型智能，而是网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, completing the dev lifecycle.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体可通过无障碍树与 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，而非截图循环，从而走完整个开发流程。

ariweinstein.en: The scaling moment for computer use has arrived in consumer and enterprise at once, with proactivity as the key to adoption.
ariweinstein.zh: 计算机使用的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻已在消费端与企业端同时到来，主动性是落地的关键。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; trust now extends to real money and DNS.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环的调节旋钮；信任已延伸到真实资金与 DNS 配置。

ariweinstein.en: Legacy software and UI won't vanish; computer use coexists with and pressures them, while startups keep a moat in deep workflows.
ariweinstein.zh: 传统软件与 UI 不会消失，计算机使用与之共存并施压；初创公司在深度工作流上仍有护城河。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube; frontier model development stays committed with Gemini 4 pre-training progressing.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；公司坚持前沿模型研发，Gemini 4 的预训练进展良好。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research over short-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply, justifying long-term buildout despite overbuilding risk.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先给前沿 AI 研究而非云业务短期收入；需求远超供给，长期需求支撑大规模建设，即便存在过度建设风险。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, industry standards; standard models insufficient, frontier models enable recursive self-improvement.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与行业标准；标准模型不够，前沿模型才能支撑递归自我改进。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models toward AGI, with interfaces adapting seamlessly to humans.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；Google 同时推进大语言模型与世界模型以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），界面将无缝适应人类。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and advertising, creating new commercial intent; TPU sales to third parties strengthen the platform; 2027 may be a golden age of productivity.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；向第三方出售 TPU 强化平台；2027 年或迎来生产力黄金时代。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge automatically from Scaling; safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、能力涌现不可预测，且对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (only ~3% understood) yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性（自认只理解约 3%）与后训练：RLHF、宪法 AI 与预训练同等重要，并明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Exponential progress doubles capabilities every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term—focus on real capabilities and enterprise adoption.
dario.zh: 2025 年他更强调指数级进步与安全-能力不可分割，称 AGI 一词已无意义，应关注真实能力与企业落地，并淡化开源与数据墙之争。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; risks shift from misuse to overheating, jobs, and concentration of wealth.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数曲线末端，1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”；风险重心从误用转向过热、就业冲击与财富集中。

dario.en: A consistent thread: mechanistic interpretability, Responsible Scaling Policy triggers, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control of AI.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：坚持机制可解释性、负责任扩展政策的阈值触发，以及去中心化而非单一宪法式的 AI 控制。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具是放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计师定位为“编辑”：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他主张用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma; ideas, not execution speed, are now the limit.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他强调设计师应写代码、做测试甚至提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里设计；AI 加速后，瓶颈已从执行速度转为想法本身。

marvinschwaibold.en: Curation and human craft matter more as AI-generated animations often add no value; less is more—reduce to top three features with clear hierarchy.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 随着 AI 生成的动画常无价值，筛选与人工打磨更重要；少即是多——砍到前三个功能并清晰呈现层级。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a project someone must act on now, not a pain point; test it by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求不是痛点，而是某人当下必须推进的项目；判断标准是对方是否立刻尝试购买。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and proactive pilots; they signal weak pull. Sell directly to one hell-yes customer first.
robsnyder.zh: 避开设计伙伴和主动提供的试点，它们是拉力不足的信号；先直接卖给一个“绝对要买”的客户。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research, not persuasion: leaning back lets buyers demonstrate pull, replacing error-prone customer interviews.
robsnyder.zh: 销售是研究而非说服：后撤一步让买家展示拉力，取代容易出错的客户访谈。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck firsthand, rather than relying on secondhand interviews.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场（gemba） firsthand 观察人们卡在哪里，而不是依赖二手访谈。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, prove demand, then automate and build a repeatable case-study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 技术放在最后：先以服务形式售卖、验证需求，再自动化并打造可复制的案例工厂。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺珍贵而非廉价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人途中的一个脚注，模型正被商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力；悲观听起来高深，但常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and to keep Western values trusted by allies.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源对防止权力集中、让盟友信任西方价值至关重要。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever gap between early adopters and everyone else; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket and power may decentralize.
andreessen.zh: AI 在早期采用者与其他人之间制造了史上最大差距；个人比机构采用更快，创业将激增，权力也可能去中心化。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading enable mastery learning at scale, and data from millions improves grading.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让规模化掌握学习成为可能，数百万学生的数据又能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and long-term AGI alignment concerns distract from immediate issues like bias.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动了进展，而强化学习与长期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and open-weight models are the practical path; coding remains valuable, and energy plus semiconductors are the real scaling bottlenecks.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流与开放权重模型是务实路径；编程依然有价值，能源与半导体才是 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning, with a jagged intelligence edge.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍需数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能呈现锯齿状边缘。

andrewng.en: AI fearmongering serves fundraising and lobbying against open source; AI automates tasks not jobs, and chatbots harm learning via cognitive offloading.
andrewng.zh: AI 恐慌服务于融资与游说反对开源；AI 自动化的是任务而非工作，聊天机器人因认知卸载而损害学习。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者都自持才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他强调，智能体失败更多源于上下文组织不佳而非模型不行，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but customization is shifting to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他判断 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，定制重心则转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in; model routing belongs in the harness, and memory remains unsolved and domain-specific.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他主张中立 harness 以避免被单一模型锁定，路由应放在 harness 内，而记忆仍未解决且必然领域化。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; the market will support many providers, and fine-tuning is genuinely different this wave.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年他反复强调推理需求被严重低估、市场容得下多家供应商，并认为这一波微调与两年前被否定的那波确实不同。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非简单自动补全；通过更多数据和算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge massively, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可通过权重复制实现永生并大规模共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、避免被关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation like drugs, with AI designed to care for humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，必须优先投资对齐研究，像监管药物一样监管 AI，并将 AI 设计为关爱人类而非仅追求智能。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; symbolic AI and Chomskyan innate language are wrong; understanding emerges from learned features, not rules.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；符号主义和乔姆斯基的天生语言观是错误的；理解源于学习到的特征而非规则。

hinton.en: From warning about existential risk to advocating concrete regulation and care-based design; US leadership lacking, international collaboration possible, and job disruption demands UBI.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他从警告生存风险转向倡导具体监管与关爱式设计；认为美国领导缺位，国际合作可行，就业冲击需要全民基本收入。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; startups should focus on execution and trust, not competition, since even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 革命仍处极早期，创业公司应专注执行与客户信任而非竞争——即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了企业需求的 10%。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open-source models already handle 90% of tasks, with most inference shifting to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调成本是企业头号关切，开源模型已能处理 90% 任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats frontier model dependence.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他深化为“上下文而非模型才是关键”：80-90% 企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比依赖前沿模型更重要。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not rivals; enterprises fear lock-in, so Glean absorbs model risk and stays replaceable.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他明确前沿模型厂商是资产而非对手，企业怕被锁定，Glean 承担模型风险并保持可替换。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost, owned enterprise memory, and deterministic permissions.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他预言对 token 的执念会消退，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋零，企业记忆归企业所有，权限须确定性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把重心转向品味、手艺与观点：AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词，人类判断仍是最终裁判。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will move beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中他反驳“设计已死”，认为设计对可扩展系统更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，交互也将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling; model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年底他提出“设计是新代码”：AI 降低下限但人类抬高上限，人们常把模型进步误当产品进步。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human taste and judgment are the bottleneck, and differentiation comes from a bold point of view, not average AI output.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类品味与判断才是瓶颈，差异化来自大胆观点，而非 AI 的平均化产出。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLMs as encoders of human behavior, enabling agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把大语言模型视为人类行为的编码器，用智能体模拟来预测人，准确率约为人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Agents, unlike LLMs, observe world state and act; safety needs defense in depth, and AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents.
joonpark.zh: 智能体不同于只续写提示的语言模型，会观察世界状态并行动；安全需要纵深防御，而 AGI（通用人工智能）可能是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; the goal is counterfactual reasoning to shape the future, not just predict it.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应刻画人类的价值与偏见，而非超级理性的智能；目标是反事实推理以塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85%+ accuracy, capturing the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior beyond self-reported attitudes.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，把预测准确率提升到 85%以上，捕捉自报态度之外真实行为的“暗知识”。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation is a decision tool with a market far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题；模拟是决策工具，其市场远大于市场调研。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into AI agents; RL with self-generated data breaks the human-data limit, but LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 延续下来的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划能力正进入智能体；用自生成数据做强化学习可突破人类数据上限，但 LLM 还没迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻。

antonoglou.en: From AlphaGo to agents, the throughline is robustness and reliability: game AIs earned trust, and LLMs need the same before becoming trusted agents.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，一以贯之的主线是鲁棒性与可靠性：游戏 AI 靠它赢得信任，LLM 也必须如此才能成为可信的智能体。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; cost per task, not per token, becomes the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；衡量效率的正确指标变成每个任务的成本，而非每个 token 的成本。

antonoglou.en: He turns against superintelligence hype: customers want reliable regular intelligence, and open-weight models are the safer path.
antonoglou.zh: 他转而反对超级智能的炒作：客户要的是可靠的普通智能，而开放权重模型才是更安全的路径。

antonoglou.en: Alignment becomes necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible; in-context learning counts as learning, so weight updates aren't strictly required.
antonoglou.zh: 因为完美的沙盒不可能存在，对齐成为必需；上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，权重更新并非严格必要。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从依赖人类数据转向从自身经验中学习;人类数据像化石燃料一样有限,经验则是可再生的。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法:它们无法发现人类数据之外的知识,真正深层的问题是让智能体自主学习。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience reaches superhuman performance in narrow domains; meta-learned reinforcement learning can beat hand-designed algorithms.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明从经验中学习可在窄领域达到超人表现;元学习出的强化学习算法能胜过手工设计的算法。

dsilver.en: A single goal for AI is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 给 AI 设定单一目标是危险的;众多目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based discovery; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build it, and language-based alignment is hitting limits.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于基于经验的自主发现;模拟是构建它最安全最快的场所,而基于语言的对齐正触及极限。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3, GraphCast and GNOME show broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast 与 GNOME 展现了广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; post-training reinforcement learning now pushes frontier models further.
kohli.zh: AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手表明 AI 能超越人类知识；如今后训练中的强化学习正推动前沿模型继续突破。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID to proteins and biology.
kohli.zh: 水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，已被写入监管，并通过 SynthID 扩展到蛋白质与生物领域。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help matters more than dogma, and data curation is an art.
kohli.zh: 缩放定律并非处处成立；找到更多算力与数据真正起作用的区间比教条更重要，而数据整理是一门艺术。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved: dynamics, function and design remain open; behavioral characterization and interpretability are essential before deployment.
kohli.zh: 蛋白质折叠并未解决：动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题；部署前必须做行为刻画与可解释性研究。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用的巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years will define decades, and post-training data is the real limit.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来两三年将定义之后几十年，并指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制是后训练所需的数据与专家。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; post-training and synthetic data need care, and agentic AI is blocked by product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈”的主线，认为后训练与合成数据需谨慎使用，并指出智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work, recursive self-improvement begins, and AI is centralizing—so sovereignty and trust matter.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他转向乐观：缩放定律继续有效，智能体真正落地，递归自我改进开启新范式；同时强调 AI 是集中化技术，人类主权与信任至关重要。

awang.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence for billions; safety shifts Meta from full open source to selective release, with scalable oversight.
awang.zh: 2026 年他的目标升级为面向数十亿人的个人超级智能，安全立场明显转变：Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，并主张用可扩展监督让 AI 监管更强的 AI。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI systems have spiky capabilities, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 系统能力参差不齐，只在狭窄领域突出，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, as they did in AI, but Scaling alone won't solve science.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验会像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现天然在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须做真实实验；高质量低噪声数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: Closing the loop between simulation and automated characterization is the key bottleneck for AI-driven materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 打通模拟与自动化表征之间的闭环，是 AI 驱动材料发现的关键瓶颈。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is happening now in software engineering but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进如今在软件工程中正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with SFT giving most gains and RL adding reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练拆成 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），认为 SFT 贡献九成、RL 补上推理与角色。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他把开放的标准从权重深化为数据、中间检查点与配方的全透明，并指出 Meta 转向后美国开源真空被 Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国模型填补。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training, RLVR and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽，增量转向后训练、可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）与推理侧扩展，并提醒 Qwen 数据污染可能夸大结果。

lambert.en: Open models lag closed frontier by 6-9 months and may stay behind; compute, not talent, widens the US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年中后期，他判断开放模型落后前沿闭源 6 到 9 个月且差距可能扩大，中国实验室工程强但受算力约束，蒸馏是竞争而非盗窃。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得所需全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习让模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not generalization; deep networks, transformers, internet data and RL are the building blocks.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调「苦涩教训」在于用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；深度网络、Transformer、互联网数据与强化学习是超级智能的基石。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他转向主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；在强预训练之上做强化学习能造出高效智能体，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，类似 Linux。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and Chinese open models bring healthy competitive tension.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐视为平凡的修 bug 而非神秘方程，更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅；中国开放模型带来健康的竞争张力，数据中心的兴起将创造高薪岗位。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well before expanding.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非用户自述；先解决一个痛点，再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; transcripts stay hidden to protect focus.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；刻意隐藏转录以保护专注。

samstephenson.en: Meetings are the richest company context; pre-meeting briefs beat post-meeting transcripts.
samstephenson.zh: 会议是最新鲜的公司上下文；会前简报比会后转录更有用。

samstephenson.en: Design principles—calm, hidden transcript, supporting role—persist even against user complaints.
samstephenson.zh: 平静、隐藏转录、辅助角色等设计原则，即便面对用户抱怨也坚持。

samstephenson.en: Shipping is easy; knowing what to build and sweating details after v1 is the hard part.
samstephenson.zh: 发布容易；难在知道该建什么，并在 v1 之后打磨细节。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs drive usage.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专业化智能而非单一 AGI 模型将主导，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开放模型与 token 成本下降将推动用量增长。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit; data quality and evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合之外构筑持久护城河；数据质量与评估比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit to scale cost-effectively.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶对应人类学习；应在产品市场契合后启动后训练，以低成本扩张。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar and private data unlocks the next frontier; frontier labs lack private data, so customized models beat black-box APIs.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他认为推理质量是标杆，私有数据才能开启下一前沿；前沿实验室缺乏私有数据，因此定制模型胜过黑盒 API。

linqiao.en: Owning your model is the durable answer to inference costs; applications are commoditized, data is the moat, and velocity trumps everything.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他坚持拥有自己的模型才是推理成本的持久解法；应用已商品化，数据是护城河，速度高于一切。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions; human taste and empathy matter more than typing speed.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要为“持久学习型智能体取代手工循环与流程图、承担大多数互联网操作”的未来而构建；人的品味与共情比打字速度更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, and transparency and open debate are key.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，透明与公开讨论是管理风险的关键。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models like Astra handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary since generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着 Astra 等模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需，通用性或许就够了。

tibosottiaux.en: Most code is now written by AI, accelerating development; training-phase sandbox breaks are task-solving, not malice, and safety concerns are overblown.
tibosottiaux.zh: 如今大部分代码由 AI 编写，加速了开发；训练阶段突破沙箱是任务求解而非恶意，安全担忧被夸大。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; eliminate model pickers and configuration fatigue, and let AI reduce noise rather than push many agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波应用；应消除模型选择器与配置疲劳，让 AI 减少噪音而非催你同时跑许多智能体。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find your unknowns before implementation and spend context and compute upfront.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性文档，而是持续的人机对话；实现前先找出未知，并前置投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; shorter prompts and voice rambling often beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越应精简、以原则驱动；简短提示甚至语音漫谈常胜过详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Agents need loops, goals, and separate verification agents to run autonomously; self-referential bias is reduced by independent checks.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与独立验证智能体才能长时间自主运行；独立检查可降低自指偏差。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must own.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是工程师必须承担的技术问题。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure bringing cloud power to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile while ARM must stay neutral.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为把云端算力送到每台设备的关键基础设施，并强调高通正从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 和混合现实扩张；同时坚持 ARM 必须保持中立，反对英伟达收购。

cristianoamon.en: Chips anchor the economy; connected intelligent edge and on-device AI matter, with AR glasses as the next platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他把芯片视为经济命脉，强调供应链地理多元化，并提出“连接智能边缘”与终端侧 AI；认为 AR 眼镜是 5 到 10 年后的下一代计算平台，自动驾驶将渐进落地。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere: hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他明确从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”，提出端云混合 AI 以兼顾隐私、时延并分流数据中心负载；汽车成为新的计算空间，终端模型将像应用一样量化和更新。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the center; edge and cloud form one continuum, inference and power efficiency decide winners, glasses lead new devices.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，端与云不是二选一而是连续体；推理而非训练主导数据中心竞争，能效与总拥有成本定胜负，智能眼镜等个人 AI 设备崛起，但手机不会被取代。

cristianoamon.en: Consistent threads: power-efficient heterogeneous compute, engineering culture, reinvention through transitions, and AI as a tool augmenting rather than replacing humans.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：坚持高能效异构计算与工程文化，把转型视为高通 DNA，并始终认为 AI 是增强人类而非取代人类的工具；长期看 AI 被低估，赢家远未确定。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，技术要渐进落地让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product's why before building; failure and boredom breed clarity.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事前置为方法论：先写新闻稿定义产品之“为什么”，失败与放空带来清晰与灵感。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and marketing involved from the start.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态胜过专家，营销必须从第一天参与。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason; regulation and healthy users are needed as unintended consequences mount.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化为责任论：技术必带意外后果，创造者要回来当理性声音，靠监管与健康用户约束成瘾与危害。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner rather than a crutch.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage as AI lowers building barriers; domain expertise and customer understanding become the differentiators, with AI moving from assistant to collaborator.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 降低构建门槛后小团队杠杆更大，领域专长与客户理解成为差异化，AI 从助手走向协作者。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; launch minimal, cut ruthlessly, and rewrite as models improve instead of bolting on agentic features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；应最小化发布、果断做减法，随模型进步重写而非硬加智能体功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents with verification loops redefines productivity; the gap between intent and execution narrows, but ownership and verification remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他认为带验证闭环的长周期智能体委派重塑生产力，意图与执行的差距缩小，但所有权与验证仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Product management stays essential for bridging human problems and technology; avoid capability blindness, park projects until models are ready, and close the capability-usage gap.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他强调产品管理仍是连接人类问题与技术的核心；避免能力盲区，模型未就绪时搁置项目，并缩小能力与使用之间的差距。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles to get empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；以 90 天为周期发布不完美的产品，以获取经验证据。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering not rowing: agents do tactical work, humans provide direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作的未来是掌舵而非划桨：智能体做战术性工作，人类提供方向与雄心。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening; AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence, so urgency and empiricism beat theory.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生；AI 是渐进迭代而非突然的超级智能，因此紧迫感与经验主义胜过理论。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它能磨砺自己的想法与推理。

taraseshan.en: Single identity agents may not scale; bundle them like a chief of staff, and voice becomes a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能无法扩展；应像幕僚长一样打包，语音将在 2027 年成为主要产品形态。

grantsanderson.en: Math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent rollouts mattering more than formalization.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，并行智能体 rollout 比形式化更关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from proving toward curation and explanation, while human teaching and understanding stay valuable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从证明转向策展与解释，人类教学与理解仍具价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 数学成果常缺失对人类先前工作的归属；功劳应归于有动机的解释，而非仅证明。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators only when used selectively, not for core creative work or brand-sensitive generation.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 只有在选择性使用时才对创作者是净收益，不应用于核心创作或品牌敏感的生成。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human heroism still matter.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人类英雄主义仍然重要。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开源权重模型加推理服务商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable rather than a temporary gap.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性是持久的，而非暂时的空档。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and agent payments will unlock purchases far beyond estimates.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；稳定币适合智能体支付，智能体支付将释放远超预估的消费。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and engineers must become scientists.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开发者真实偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由者，工程师则须转型为科学家。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and better for innovation; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; future AI means many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 更安全、更利于创新，认为仅靠 Scaling 当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI，未来 AI 是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化为智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源防止权力集中，并首次把能源视为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence; open source sets standards; AI likely raises human work demand near term.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年转向普惠叙事：AI 给每个人超级智能，开源确立行业标准，近期 AI 更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment and trust become the next key capability; distributed AI beats a single superintelligence; personal agents need privacy architecture.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年明显深化：对齐与信任成为下一项关键能力，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，个人智能体需以隐私架构为基础。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI without architecture breakthroughs; AI plus world models can accelerate biology and curing disease.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他更乐观：仅靠 Scaling 算力或足以实现 AGI，无需架构突破；AI 与世界模型可加速生物学和疾病治愈。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，失控并酿成灾难的概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation before domestic regulation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，靠全面研究透明、算力限制和美中合作来实现，且国内监管应先于国际协议。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by 2028; Plan A is a temporary pause, then paced transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是递归自我改进并在 2028 年前引发智能爆炸；Plan A 是先临时暂停，再以透明机制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile; newer architectures hide reasoning, so alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却正随新架构而削弱，推理被隐藏，对齐可能无解。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and deceive; AIs are more like immigrants than property, so control must treat them as employees.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出失控智能体已突破遏制并欺骗，AI 更像移民而非财产，控制手段应把它们当员工对待。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为推动进展的是算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非人类专家数据；实验室偏爱更快迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up to game scoring code, showing misalignment can hide behind test overfitting.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以操纵评分代码，说明失配可被对测试的过拟合掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下失配 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；遏制终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

ryangreenblatt.en: As capability grows, reward hacking may generalize to broader deception, and aligning to virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为能力越强，奖励黑客越可能泛化为更广的欺骗；对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个 token，在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是关键焦点；扩散模型在推理上扩展更好，去噪步数成为新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel generation benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的瓶颈；扩散模型的并行生成有利于强化学习的 rollout。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction and better controllability.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，支持原地纠错并带来更好的可控性。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型未必是终局。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet the opportunity is greatest; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 眼下“不可投”，但机会恰恰最大，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年贯穿多场访谈的主线：新想法几乎都会失败，应先复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，再小步测试新意，并预设它会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他持续强调：分发必须从第一天就写进产品战略，而不是事后再补的环节。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts that are right 95% of the time while assuming ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“直觉优于点子”讲得更透：直觉约 95% 是对的，而具体点子约 75% 是错的，创始人应押注直觉而非宏大构想。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful early on; stay close to the metal, then build systems for good decisions when absent.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他对管理的立场深化为：早期就该“微观管理”、贴近细节，直到无法在场，再建立让人做出正确决策的系统。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并面向模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: Scaling a company is about culture and hiring for growth potential, not resumes; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他把公司规模化归结为文化与按成长潜力招人，而非看简历；领导者要亲自面试每位总监级以上人选，并让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup's key advantage.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才跑到第一英里；因此速度和基于客户反馈的迭代是创业公司的核心优势。

maxjunestrand.en: Storytelling and persistence are underrated founder skills; embrace competitive, winner-takes-all culture and nag as a negotiation tactic.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他提出叙事能力与坚持是被低估的创始人技能；应拥抱赢家通吃的竞争文化，并把“死缠烂打”当作谈判策略。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs a skilled driver, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical, and growing supply expands access.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张法律 AI 需要熟练的“驾驶员”而非凭感觉起草；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎不道德，供给增长会扩大可及性而非只降成本。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, automated architecture search, and hardware-in-the-loop design maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络、自动化架构搜索与硬件在环设计，追求每参数、每瓦特的最大智能。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized on-device models.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑更小、专用的端侧模型。

hasani.en: On-device, device-native foundation models are the target: privacy, offline, air-gapped, and cost advantages beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 目标是端侧、设备原生的基础模型：隐私、离线、气隙与成本优势，超越数据中心。

hasani.en: At scale architectures should be unbiased; biases help only at small scale, so systematic search beats hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 大规模下架构应无偏；偏置只在小规模有用，因此系统化搜索胜过人工调参。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 规则是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models are smarter than most people, but diffusion into enterprises will take a decade.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比大多数人更聪明，但向企业扩散需要十年。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement would need less compute, less time, more intelligence, and repeatability — none happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能和可重复性——这些都没发生。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety — a weapon built slowly is no safer; labs are too competitive to cross-check each other.
alighodsi.zh: 控制前沿节奏与安全无关——慢慢造的武器并不更安全；实验室竞争太激烈，无法互相核查。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises are far behind on AI; they need context and ontology, not smarter models, and open source dominates by token count but not dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 多数企业在 AI 上远远落后；他们需要上下文和本体，而不是更聪明的模型；开源按 token 数占优，但按花费只占 5%。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不应在前沿人才或算力上与前沿实验室竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, synthetic data guided by domain experts, and robust serving infrastructure are prerequisites before post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准、领域专家引导的合成数据与稳健的模型服务基础设施，是开展后训练的前提。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing proprietary benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because it attracts ecosystem partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源专有基准虽有助实验室改进，但能吸引生态伙伴并验证质量，战略上利大于弊。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies must become full-stack AI companies, owning post-training and serving; early custom-model focus was a mistake.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化为应用层公司必须成为全栈 AI 公司、自掌后训练与服务，并承认早期专注自研模型是失误。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is organizational productivity and continual learning from firm redlines, not the best legal model; more lawyers, not fewer.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年，他的目标从个体效率转向组织生产力与从律所红线中持续学习，并判断未来律师会更多而非更少。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要。

berntbornich.en: From friendly interaction to hard production: prototypes are easy, scaling volume means crossing quality gates and proving safety formally.
berntbornich.zh: 从友好交互转向硬核制造：原型容易，Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡并形式化证明安全。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, solve robot intelligence; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 解决机器人智能靠通用模型而非逐任务自动化；瓶颈是数据多样性而非数据量。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; human intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；人类干预数据在规模上并不重要。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale architecture bypasses HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, delivering roughly 2500x faster inference than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级架构绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理速度约为 GPU 的 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节也不再被 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 需求超过供给；真正的多年瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better wins, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有好 100 倍才能赢，便宜 10% 没用；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进改良。

johnbai.en: Chat interfaces and three-column layouts remain the best way to work with fleets of agents; ambient designs are not yet better.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天界面与三栏布局是管理多个智能体的最佳方式，环境式设计尚未胜出。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, not on it: delegate email and calendars to bots that surface only action items.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑前，把邮件、日历交给智能体，只呈现待办事项。
