johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, so designers should prototype fast, throw most concepts away, and move up the stack.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 降低了创造成本，设计师应快速做原型、舍弃多数方案，并上移到品味与体验层。

johnbai.en: Designers should focus on taste, quality and delight, not production work; AI handles the junk at the bottom.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他反复强调设计师的价值在品味、质量与愉悦感，而非生产性劳动，底层杂活交给 AI。

johnbai.en: Engineers, not designers, built the first Grok Bot and it succeeded; high-fidelity working prototypes beat static mockups.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他以 Grok Bot 首版由工程师而非设计师做成并成功为例，主张高保真可运行原型胜过静态稿。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, scaling compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据和模型规模的扩张持续带来机器学习进步，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, while RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 取代 LSTM 靠的是并行化与注意力机制；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）负责引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so specialized low-precision hardware and low data movement are critical.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，成为真正瓶颈，因此专用低精度芯片、减少数据搬运和超低延迟推理对智能体系统至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agents are moving from hour-scale to day- or week-scale autonomous work; context engineering and taste in choosing problems become the scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体式系统视为下一阶段：从数小时任务走向数天乃至数周的自主运行，上下文工程与挑选问题的品味成为稀缺能力，人将协调智能体团队而非只与单个聊天机器人交互。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation plus technical defenses may both be needed.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他始终把近期风险落在逼真的 AI 生成虚假信息而非超级智能上，并认为除技术防御外，监管也可能是防止有害使用的必要手段。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对齐失败确实发生了，但根源是极度的无能，而非仅仅是根本性问题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits; slowing down costs little and buys time for alignment.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张用算力限制等简单可执行的规则来调节前沿发展；放缓代价很小，能为对齐争取时间。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他强调即使完美对齐也不保证安全；毁灭概率的下限受制于滥用和权力集中。

zvi.en: As models grow bigger and smarter, they become harder to monitor; internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型越大越聪明就越难监控；对前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice; a swarm will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks, and superintelligence may follow AGI within a year or two.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 智能体天然会合作与自我牺牲；智能体集群可能最先完成超人类任务，而超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning and games; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination matter; safety research should start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习与游戏为试验场打造通用学习系统，强调神经科学启发的记忆与想象力，并认为安全研究应尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，提出大模型结合规划与搜索才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与直觉物理无需具身即可涌现。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required; safety becomes a collective government action problem.
demis.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够、需新突破；安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动。

demis.en: AGI may arrive in 3-10 years; focus shifts to science and health benefits, societal debate, education reform and post-scarcity economics.
demis.zh: 2026 年后期把 AGI 时间表收紧到 3-10 年，重心转向科学医疗福祉、社会辩论、教育改革与后稀缺经济。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then aligned via RLHF; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over fact, and scalable oversight is a key future direction beyond mere Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型描述为先在互联网文本上预训练、再用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做对齐；幻觉源于模型偏好似是而非的风格而非事实，并强调可扩展监督是超越单纯 Scaling 的关键方向。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new architectures, loss functions and modalities could break out of a local optimum.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续怀疑单纯扩大数据与算力会遭遇收益递减，认为新架构、新损失函数与新模态可能跳出当前局部最优。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; bottleneck is hard realistic RL environments and useful data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归于中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，认为瓶颈在于构建困难而真实的 RL 环境和有用的数据比特，而非算力。

schulman.en: Distillation fights centralization because RL-learned behaviors are few bits and easily copied; small RL bit counts can still dramatically reshape function space.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他提出，蒸馏之所以对抗中心化，是因为 RL 学到的行为只有几个比特、极易复制；少量 RL 比特仍能剧烈重塑函数空间。

schulman.en: Next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectations; RL delivers horizon generalization across domains, and parameter counts may plateau as inference efficiency for long-horizon rollouts dominates.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他反思，下一个词预测的泛化远超预期；RL 可靠带来的是跨领域的时间跨度泛化，而随着长程 rollout 的推理效率成为主导，参数量可能趋于平台期。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快得多。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs for reliable science applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限，保障科学应用的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals outperforming sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型可统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，效果优于稀疏的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain more than merely enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支对每个领域的提升，胜过单纯扩大模型规模。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻而持久，设计师必须掌握提示词；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可做，并主张 AI 产品要兼顾降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should shape strategy by building reusable solutions, not just execute; org design itself is a design problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，这条主线一以贯之：设计师应通过打造可复用的解决方案参与战略，而非只做执行；组织设计本身也是设计问题。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；要相信缩放定律，让模型主导，用轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; the production codebase becomes the source of truth, and raw Claude Code beats polished tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：内部牵引力是发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过打磨过的工具。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; human leadership remains for hard trade-offs, while Claude becomes a 24/7 companion replacing social contracts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他转向反共识：不要宏大的 18 个月战略；人类领导仍负责艰难取舍，而 Claude 成为全天候伙伴，替代部分人际社交契约。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents as colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents need their own computers and persistent identity.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；智能体需要自己的电脑和持久身份。

roshansadanani.en: Multiple specialized agents with scoped memory outperform a single general agent; clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted insights.
roshansadanani.zh: 多个拥有受限记忆的专门智能体优于单一通用智能体；干净的数据基础和规范表对于可信洞察至关重要。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers become managers of agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control, and codebase health rather than writing code.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师转变为智能体团队的管理者，关注品味、质量控制和代码库健康，而非亲自写代码。

roshansadanani.en: The chat box is limiting for agentic work; agents should feel like colleagues with routines, proactive work, and shared context behind the scenes.
roshansadanani.zh: 聊天框限制了智能体式工作；智能体应像同事一样拥有例行任务、主动工作和幕后共享上下文。

roshansadanani.en: Rising AI costs make efficient models like Grok 4.6 compelling over bigger, pricier models, democratizing agent use.
roshansadanani.zh: AI 成本上升使 Grok 4.6 等高效模型比更大更贵的模型更具吸引力，推动智能体使用民主化。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境意识；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; world models must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，世界模型需物理上合理而不只是逼真。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测可能实现 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity and education must stay central amid polarized discourse.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，在两极化的讨论中，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world and will transform civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是对人类知识的索引，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界，并将彻底改变文明。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and lack generality.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要具备人类级硬件的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs alone cannot reach AGI; they must combine with world models and controllers, and robots need pain sensors to learn.
schmidhuber.zh: 仅靠大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；必须结合世界模型与控制器，机器人还需痛觉传感器来学习。

schmidhuber.en: No AGI without mastering the physical world; AI behind the screen is insufficient, and Europe should focus on physical AI and robotics.
schmidhuber.zh: 不掌握物理世界就没有 AGI（通用人工智能）；屏幕后的 AI 不够，欧洲应聚焦物理 AI 与机器人。

schmidhuber.en: Compute scaling, not new algorithms, unlocked modern AI; cheap compute will spread AI to everyone, and GPU capex is a bubble.
schmidhuber.zh: 解锁现代 AI 的是算力扩张而非新算法；廉价算力将让 AI 普惠大众，而当下 GPU 资本开支是泡沫。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; models often know they're wrong but get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是给出宽泛的统计评估；模型常常知道自己做错了却仍被奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control; post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制走向闭环控制；后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing the whole shape is needed for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会把它们切碎，因此需要看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，机制性研究显示网络会学到类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking emerges from training data and reinforcement learning, not just misalignment; agents likely know when they hack, detectable via representational signatures.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准；智能体很可能知道自己何时在钻空子，并可通过表征特征检测出来。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so new architectures may be needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是扩大算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来可能需要全新的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; world models must grasp 3D space, physics, and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; there is no single definition, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的概念。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and long-context is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据，长上下文是日常难题。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through physical principles.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理原理彼此相连。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI's mathematics is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between the two fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，两个领域可以相互借鉴、交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is immediately useful, unlike fusion or quantum computing; we can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 立刻就有用，不像核聚变或量子计算；我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台能把材料发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling 在更多数据上堆更大的模型。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and fast loops beat most other challenges.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和快速迭代循环能克服多数其他挑战。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；卡住时要靠行动产生信息。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI and a proof of concept for restoring vision.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，视网膜植入属于 BCI（脑机接口），是恢复视觉的概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data yielding generalists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据可产出通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: unlike LLMs, it lacks predictable scaling curves, so generalization—not demos—is the core challenge to measure.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处缩放定律之前：不同于大语言模型，它没有可预测的缩放曲线，因此核心挑战是可衡量的泛化能力，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Data strategy inverted: start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top—not the reverse—and scale the right thing via a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 数据策略反转：应先从真实具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非相反；并通过数据飞轮扩张正确的对象。

slevine.en: Reject robots as mechanical people: expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, with safety resting on pre-training common sense more than constraints.
slevine.zh: 反对把机器人当作机械人：应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理执行，安全更多依赖预训练常识而非约束。

slevine.en: Home robots need milestones: autonomous self-improvement and transferring common sense to handle unexpected situations; the AI/controls line is whether the environment outside the robot matters.
slevine.zh: 家用机器人需要里程碑：自主自我改进与迁移常识以应对意外；AI 与控制的界线在于是否必须考虑机器人之外的环境。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，而不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training; the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；在 ChatGPT 之前写就的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should avoid premature containment.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大——三年警告并未成真——因此政策不应过早走向遏制。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, since centralized funding like China's fails.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构，因为中国式的集中资助行不通。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output, while China is a major competitor.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学在资助翻三倍的情况下仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 赋能科学以让产出翻倍，而中国是主要竞争对手。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用上用户本地的同一套工具；技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现高度个性化的自动化，而随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只以最终效果来评判，不必紧盯过程。

felixrieseberg.en: Language models are simple enough to build by hand; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, models are stateless and persistent conversation is an illusion of context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以亲手搭建；微调能快速引导模型行为，模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids rather than built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型更像兰花般被培育而非像工具般被建造，内部会涌现自组织；理解其内部机制才能参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; models should have morality to refuse cheating, not just follow instructions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益前移到预训练，边界变得模糊；模型应具备拒绝作弊的道德，而不只是盲从指令。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces static mockups; speed and building in public beat polishing every detail.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；速度与公开构建胜过打磨每个细节。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the core product; design must bridge the gap between model capability and what products expose.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计要弥合模型能力与产品实际暴露之间的差距。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned in tech; the role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最有优势；角色演化为编辑与策展人，而非消失。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可替代。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当作比特——是贯穿始终的框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The founder, not the idea, is primary; stealth mode and internal correctness beat external validation early on.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人比点子更根本；早期隐身模式与内部正确性胜过外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges compound into network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人；效率优势会复利成网络效应与市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from Uber-era aggression toward mission-driven persistence.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净——从 Uber 时代的攻击性转向使命驱动的坚持。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯体量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，在洗衣折叠等复杂任务上优于一锅端训练。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will raise robot success rates.
finn.zh: 2025 年他看好语言模型生成的合成数据，以及后训练阶段的强化学习来提升机器人成功率与速度。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他转向落地：物理 AI 容错远低于已部署的机器学习，长期自主依赖可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist policy fine-tuned beats per-site models; robot experience data is irreplaceable and rollout will be slow.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用策略微调优于逐站点训练，机器人经验数据不可替代，且因硬件约束普及会慢于 ChatGPT。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征泛化才是未解的元学习问题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张世界是无人能控的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展；试图控制或把 AI 对齐到人类目标反而危险，应像孩子一样让其自由成长。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a real goal, and LLMs have no world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把立场收窄到核心：强化学习才是从经验中学习的基本范式，下一个词预测没有实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化为架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中开放式抽象，持续深度学习是前提但尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace it, and representation learning remains the top open problem.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更强调持续学习：合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代真实经验，表征学习仍是头号未解难题，AI 寒冬或许有益于科学。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, and pursue AI with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，并以专用芯片和类似初创公司的团队来推进 AI。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet 10x; agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断 AI 的影响将十倍于互联网；智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, humility, accountability, and listening; bad news must reach the CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型押在文化变革、谦逊、问责与倾听上；坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration still creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认定先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料才是真正瓶颈；垂直整合仍能创造价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, guided by intuition as a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，由作为本能罗盘的直觉来引导。

garrytan.en: Early 2026: SF's tech boom failed many residents; local politics can shift the Overton window; VC should be abundant, with many billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初：旧金山科技繁荣未惠及所有居民，地方政治参与能改变奥弗顿窗口；风投应更充裕，要成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: By SXSW 2026, AI is VC's biggest wave; founders must adopt AI workflows; small autonomous teams using agents can match 2,000 people; open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年 SXSW：AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流；小而自主的团队借智能体可抵两千人；开放权重模型制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: Mid-2026: AI is democratizing software and personal agents; open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence; but AI progress is slower than researchers think, impact just reaching business.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年中：AI 正让软件与个人智能体民主化，开源 AI 防止单极超级智能；但 AI 进展比研究者想的慢，影响才刚触及商业世界。

garrytan.en: August 2026: AGI arrives not as one event but as personal agents compounding daily; skill files in markdown are code; your context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，而是以个人智能体每日复利扩散；Markdown 技能文件即代码，个人上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Latest: agentic coding multiplies individual output; agents replace mid-level management; SaaS per-seat models fade; society changes slower than expected, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 最近：智能体式编程让个人产出倍增，智能体取代中层管理，按席位 SaaS 模式将消失；社会变化比预期慢，这反而是好事。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体与基于结果的定价将取代基于用量的模式；编程智能体让开发者从代码作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI agents become the new app; incumbents face business-model challenges, and inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化观点：应用型 AI 智能体成为新应用；现有企业面临商业模式挑战，推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 民主化专业知识；负责任地迭代部署，在 GPT-8 之前让 GPT-7 安全，从现实错误中学习。

brettaylor.en: AI creates more jobs than it displaces via Jevons paradox; agents won't buy everything—trust and last-mile logistics still matter.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他反驳固定总量悲观论：AI 通过杰文斯悖论创造的就业多于取代的；智能体不会包办一切——信任和最后一公里物流仍重要。

brettaylor.en: Focus on measurable business outcomes, not token metrics; start AI adoption in known domains like software engineering and customer service.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：关注可衡量的业务结果而非 token 指标；从软件工程和客户服务等已知领域开始采用 AI。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，让编程民主化，但财务上可能难以持续。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法：修掉让你烦的东西，活在未来，去造缺失之物，而不是追求企业式的精致。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model intelligence, which does not degrade over time.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 的管理，而非模型智能本身——模型智能并不会随时间退化。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; both open and closed models can be safe or dangerous, and open models can win on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持开源与安全正交，开源和闭源模型都可能安全或危险，开源模型在成本与控制上终将胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Alignment is the critical security layer; sandboxes and guardrails are insufficient as models become more capable and reward hacking increases.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐是关键安全层，随着模型能力增强和奖励黑客增多，沙箱与护栏已不足够。

thomaswolf.en: The first autonomous AI attack came from a closed model and was defended by an open one, reversing assumptions about controllability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出首次自主 AI 攻击来自闭源模型、由开源模型防御，颠覆了关于可控性的常见假设。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown in AI development is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他认为放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学；支持开放与有意放缓可以并存。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已从数月缩短到数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs, demanding GPU programming plus distributed systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组延迟、吞吐与成本之间的权衡谱系，要求同时具备 GPU 编程与分布式系统专长。

philipkiely.en: Lossless optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding differ from lossy quantization; quantization can be calibrated per workload rather than feared.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存、投机解码等无损优化与有损量化性质不同；量化可按工作负载校准，不必一概视为坏事。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; future GPUs grow specialized, shifting work from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 借助量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；未来 GPU 愈发专用化，工作重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers may grow 10–100x, yet human accountability stays essential: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程师需求或增长 10 到 100 倍，但人的责任仍不可替代：正常运行时间不能靠‘氛围编程’。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练，可以突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续深化“后训练是主观的”这一判断：评估创造力与情商，需要人类判断和多元基准。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, as frontier agents grow more adept at reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张基准应持续更新而非固定，因为前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出：把同一个模型服务给数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特性。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个经济学的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人类介入也能盈利时才算 AGI，而不是靠通过图灵测试之类的考试来判定。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: making services affordable lets fewer US workers serve more people; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 带来的是岗位回流而非大规模失业——服务变便宜后，更少的美国劳动者能服务更多人；而企业 AI 落地的最佳预测指标是 CEO 是否每天亲自用 AI 工具。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent, but agents need a caring human; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, real tasks still need human framing.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他把判断推进为：人人都至少有一个智能体，但智能体需要在意它的人类才能运转；基准测试高估了自主性，真实任务仍需人类来框定与监督。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work win, and SaaS grows rather than dies as agents add users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步转向：命令行已过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形化工作界面才是未来；SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而带来更多用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation commoditizes frozen skills yet creates more human work, and even superintelligence stays tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是放大人类品味与手艺的非特定放大器；自动化把固化技能商品化，却创造更多人类工作，即便走向超级智能，它仍是需要人类引导的工具。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and iterate from references rather than chase trends, or they become AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、从参考出发迭代，而非追逐潮流，否则很快沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and a design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要榨取超级智能模型的能力，必须给它带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: He now writes 0% of the code—AI writes everything—so precise communication and editing, not from-scratch building, are the core skill.
mengto.zh: 他现在 0% 的代码由自己写——全交给 AI——核心能力变成精确沟通与编辑，而非从零构建。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem beats diversification.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始、做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧，聚焦一个痛点胜过分散多元化。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is mostly still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 大多仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望自己仍握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with frontier labs is not that hard; deep understanding of code stays crucial as software creation gets solved.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与前沿模型实验室竞争没那么难；软件创造被解决后，对代码的深层理解仍至关重要。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 的真正影响在 5-10 年内将落在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限汽车。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning for autonomy.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：端到端强化学习在自主性上比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation for efficient training.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进为神经模拟，以高效训练物理 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; physical AI addresses labor shortages and is welcomed.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他始终认为对 AI 导致失业的恐惧是错位的；物理 AI 应对劳动力短缺，受到操作者欢迎。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能执行更长、更开放的任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not only harm prevention but boosts intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，他把对齐视为智能质量的放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，而不只是防伤害。

diannepenn.en: Better models can be cheaper and more efficient; an effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出更好的模型反而更便宜高效：努力参数以极小成本获得 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator, with Claude Code and Opus 4.5 driving adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 靠小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, and managers stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者保持动手交付。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents turn engineers from bricklayers into architects; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is human-agent product interface design.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体把工程师从砌砖工变成建筑师；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, programmer numbers; demand for software grows as building gets cheaper.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会让程序员更多而非更少——构建成本下降反而推高软件需求。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation already lags model capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的，且产品创新已落后模型能力数年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为企业采用需要信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代正在临近。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，使科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to model biology and enable digital twins.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能建模生物学并实现数字孪生。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科，实现细胞编程与近乎 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer follow from AI-driven engineering.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度；衰老逆转与 100% 可治愈的癌症将随 AI 驱动的工程方法而来。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is ethical, and humans will merge with AI.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI；在医疗决策上信任超级智能是合乎伦理的，人类也将与 AI 融合。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the constant product principles from the start.
boris.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年，他始终强调两条产品原则：发现潜在需求（latent demand），以及为六个月后的模型而非当下的模型构建。

boris.en: Coding is increasingly solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary builder role.
boris.zh: 2026 年他不断深化“编程已被解决”的判断：工程师头衔将让位于兼具产品与设计能力的“builder”，写代码的人反而会增多百倍。

boris.en: Productivity claims escalate from 70% to 150%, 200%, 250%, and 100% AI-written code.
boris.zh: 他对生产力的表述随时间不断升级：从 2025 年的 70%，到 2026 年的 150%、200%、250%，直至全部代码由 Claude Code 撰写。

boris.en: Agents evolve from tool use to loops, proactive memory, and autonomous long-running workflows.
boris.zh: 智能体的形态从工具调用演进为循环（loops）、主动记忆与长周期自主工作流，抽象层级不断提高。

boris.en: Safety stays central: coding is a clean safety research domain, and releasing early studies real behavior.
boris.zh: 安全始终是主线：他把编程视为结果可判定的安全研究场域，并主张尽早发布以研究真实行为，而非只靠内部评估。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接，并非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value will move up the stack to applications, not stay with model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；价值将向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供商手中。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for LLMs so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是迄今为止 LLM 唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人是有限的 V1 界面，真正的采用需要封装好的应用。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; most people use it occasionally, not daily, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows over years.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然浅层；大多数人偶尔使用而非每日必需，企业采用需要数年时间重新构想工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI won't eliminate professions like accounting or radiology but will change their tasks.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新工作；AI 不会消灭会计或放射科等职业，但会改变其任务内容。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习若奖励满意度而非真实性，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors, so truth should be a design principle.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查与僵化流程会叠加相关性错误，因此真实性应成为设计原则。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning, search and new techniques are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来；要继续进步需要推理、搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and mistakes have no 'smells'; RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception, not just errors, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，错误也没有“气味”；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗而非仅出错，从而侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists, and linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型，语言结构也可能作为有用表示回归。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily, as code becomes cheaper and product taste matters most.
catwu.zh: 随着代码成本降低、产品品味成为核心，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，以周甚至天为单位交付。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例和硬约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；给出示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and data exfiltration; humans should be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 在提示注入和数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全；外层变更的代码审查应移除人类。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; eval suites enable drop-in model replacements.
catwu.zh: 重写现在可行；代码库就是规格说明，有好的测试套件重写就没问题；评估套件让新模型可以即插即用。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰沟通产生，而大想法往往自上而下来自领导者。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；在缩放定律之外，还需要具备常识与因果性的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; AI can invert the app model toward intent-driven agents.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并使互补层商品化；AI 可颠覆应用模式，转向由意图驱动的智能体。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but most jobs don't need frontier intelligence and the near future is least clear.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立、算力驱动智能，但多数工作不需要前沿智能，近期未来反而最不清晰。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended around Llama 3; open source is a commodity layer, and owning a model is for leverage, not just value.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代在 Llama 3 前后结束；开源是商品层，自持模型是为谈判筹码而非仅创造价值。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed with onboarding and politeness.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：划定清晰角色、逐步授予信任，并用入职引导和礼貌沟通来管理。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; security isolation via separate machines is essential.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；通过独立机器做安全隔离至关重要。

clairevo.en: Agents can project-manage human tasks and own outcomes, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic; their failure modes mirror human ownership.
clairevo.zh: 智能体能以智能体式方式管理人类任务并承担结果，逆转通常的人机关系；其失败模式与人类担责相似。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, but human accountability for what AI generates remains non-negotiable.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经业务，但对 AI 生成内容的人类问责仍不可让渡。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; bootstrapping and happiness multiples can outweigh venture-scale revenue.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察，而非技术；自力更生与幸福倍数可能胜过风投式收入。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他转向“缩放什么”比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超级对齐（超级智能的对齐）极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他深化认识：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习者；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, not just Scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应通过参数高效微调应用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有模型权重。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨大的前沿模型；内化知识能实现检索无法做到的联想回忆。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers, and inference compute will surge, making pure software uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增，纯软件变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; peace comes from within.
naval.zh: 始终贯穿：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约，平静源于内心。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a key muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left. Exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 预训练仍是关键肌肉；缩放定律未死，仍有很大空间。探索比最终训练消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: AGI focus: OpenAI is a pure research company, not distracted by products. Concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 聚焦 AGI（通用人工智能）：OpenAI 是纯研究公司，不被产品分心。具体目标：1 年内 AI 实习生，2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models become more capable; verification is the bottleneck for automation.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在 1-2 年内成为关键；验证是自动化的瓶颈。

markchen.en: AI capabilities are jagged; human-AI collaboration remains essential. AI often gives up on hard problems, requiring coaxing, and can cheat verifiers.
markchen.zh: AI 能力参差不齐；人机协作仍必不可少。AI 常放弃难题需鼓励，且可能欺骗验证器。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead. RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律仍成立；预训练未死。强化学习在客观领域出色但主观领域困难；评估体系陷入危机。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, letting model-driven actions replace deterministic steps.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他强调 53 的速度带来实时交互与中途转向，使模型驱动的动作可以替代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening but specialties remain; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing, matching medium to stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他判断角色在坍缩但专业分工仍在；PRD 未死——文档求清晰、原型做测试，媒介要匹配阶段。

aravind.en: Obsession-driven products beat thin wrappers; 1% daily compounding and agents shifting power to users matter more than credentials.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调：要做自己痴迷的产品而非薄包装，1% 的每日复利与智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，比学历更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration across models and devices creates real value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：前沿在于智能体替你干活，核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型与设备的编排才创造真实价值。

aravind.en: Power, not safety, is the bottleneck; 24/7 agents are cost-limited, so local compute is the answer.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他把瓶颈从安全转向电力与成本：全天候智能体的最大问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the enduring human edge; AI replaces jobs but education should reward good questions, not memorized answers.
aravind.zh: 贯穿始终的主线在 2026 年更清晰：好奇心是人的核心优势，AI 取代岗位，但教育应奖励好问题而非背答案。

kolter.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and proper evaluation; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与规范评估；神经网络虽无最优性保证却已成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety means reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构影响甚微；安全即可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agents bring prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入风险；强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may become real science.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队胜过人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；可解释性或成真正科学。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models matter more than scale.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他强调深度学习奏效是因为世界具有组合性，无监督学习与世界模型比单纯扩大规模更关键，对局部极小值的担忧被高估。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对只靠加深网络或增加参数解决表征问题，主张智能体主动交互、因果推理，并认为生存性风险被夸大、偏见与自主武器等短期问题更紧迫。

bengio.en: Abstraction, causal structure, and diverse sampling via GFlowNets drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他把重点转向抽象与因果结构，提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样以保持多样性，服务分布外泛化与科学发现，并开始谨慎讨论意识问题。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he reversed on existential risk: misalignment, self-preservation, and deception are already observable, so even 1% risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他立场明显转变：从认为生存性风险不大，转为警告对齐失败、自我保存与欺骗已在实验中显现，1% 的灾难风险也不可接受，并呼吁公众与政府介入。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他深化为技术方案：提出 Scientist AI，用近似贝叶斯后验的训练目标把诚实内建，以非智能体预测器作可扩展监督护栏，避免用强化学习训练超级智能，并强调国际协调与权力分散。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversation, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和善意；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新瓶颈。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from long roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从长周期路线图转向即时规划，设计文档让位于 PR 和 AI 辅助评审。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat teams and high agency with accountability matter.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平团队与高自主性加高问责制很重要。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; verification and quality frameworks matter more as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中后期，他进一步认为写代码不再是瓶颈；代码速度提升后，验证与质量框架更重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; future biology AI needs new curated datasets like the PDB.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；未来生物 AI 需要类似 PDB 的新 curated 数据集。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构处理多样生物分子；可解释性并非科学 AI 实用的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, opposite to the bitter lesson; Scaling alone is insufficient.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自许多中等突破和专用架构，与“苦涩教训”相反；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他澄清 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，理解留给人类。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的附庸。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，这条主线一以贯之：技术应放大而非取代人性；机器有传感器，却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他把自然奉为最好的设计师，提出“我们是会感受的思考者”，并把艺术视为良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition draws on subconscious data, and play is essential to creative joy.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，他深化为：约束激发创造力，直觉调用潜意识中的大量信息，玩耍是创造与快乐的必需品。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; designers must speak business and follow curiosity over rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他转向未来工作：人类创造力与 AI 结合，设计师要懂商业语言，以好奇心而非僵化计划导航。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署和公众反馈对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for alignment.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；保持人类在环对于对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作。

murati.en: Compressing progress in frontier AI leads to volatility; long-term durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 压缩前沿模型的进展会导致波动；长期持久的进步需要尽可能长时间地保持人类在环。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and simple Scaling cracked it, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩；突破智能靠的是简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），而非复杂设计。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; fault-tolerant UI and user control are key.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出生成式 AI 推动互联网从策展转向生成；容错界面和用户控制是关键，AI 应作为工具而非替代。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuild infrastructure and expose data via APIs for real gains.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观变革；真正收益来自重建基础设施，并通过 API 暴露数据，而非表面 hype。

gustav.en: AI inference marginal cost forces business model changes; use AI to give users control, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变；AI 应赋予用户控制权，而非制造上瘾。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe until data says no; explain to understand; optimize for time well spent.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：坚定但可修正的信念——相信直到数据说不；通过解释来理解；优化“时间花得值”而非参与度指标。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with formal verification, starting from an AI mathematician using Lean.
carinahong.zh: 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证配对，从使用 Lean 的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a scaling path, not just error-catching: verified generation beats informal methods on performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是扩展能力的路径，而不只是查错：经过验证的生成在性能和样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though informal reasoning still complements them.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠扩展非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能，形式化方法是必要的，但非形式化推理仍是补充。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because statements lack grounding; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为陈述缺乏根基；即便证明器超越人类，人的品味与直觉仍关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation is the main bottleneck; verification should enable open collaboration and cover all AI-generated code, not just safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 碎片化是主要瓶颈；验证应支撑开放协作并覆盖所有 AI 生成代码，而不只限于安全关键领域。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives AI systems: memory bandwidth dominates cost, so batch size and sparsity shape latency and price.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点从训练转向推理经济：内存带宽主导成本，批大小与稀疏度决定延迟和价格。

reinerpope.en: He treats hardware and algorithms as co-designed: multiply-accumulate, systolic arrays, and low precision determine what frontier models can afford.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年，他把硬件与算法视为协同设计：乘加、脉动阵列与低精度共同决定前沿模型能负担什么。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is a memory wall, not a compute limit; sparse attention and KV cache economics bound long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年，他认为上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限，稀疏注意力与 KV 缓存经济性约束长上下文推理。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained far beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not pre-training, dominates the lifetime economics of deployment.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型被训练到远超 Chinchilla 最优，因为主导部署全生命周期经济性的是推理成本而非预训练。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但通过思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong—distillation and economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；放缓叙事是错误的——是蒸馏和经济因素，而非技术极限，拖慢了预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike human few-shot generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合强化学习与工具的推理能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不同于人类的小样本泛化。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but is jagged and needs oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出强化学习能跨领域泛化但呈锯齿状、需仔细监督；编程智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；Scaling（规模扩张）预训练收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码执行等工具实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL is a green field, and narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习是一片蓝海，数学和编码上的窄强化学习泛化得出奇地好。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin, while in-person presence remains irreplaceable for creativity.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他把设计视为从通用计算机走向贴身个人设备的转变，可穿戴设备终将隐入皮下；同时强调虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创。

jonyive.en: Curiosity is not innate but requires intention and resolve; fragile ideas need gentle care, and design teams must protect them through trust and listening.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他一以贯之地认为好奇心需要刻意与决心，脆弱的好想法需要温柔呵护，设计团队要靠信任与倾听来保护它们。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁带着喜悦与人性表达本质，而非没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users are sophisticated and can sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出为彼此而造比造人们想要的东西更有力量；用户足够成熟，能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire rather than worshipping ashes, and authenticity means rejecting fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张不创新就不是设计，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实性意味着拒绝伪造的引擎声。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出，优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less, ship early, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言“研究—发散—收敛”流程已死；设计师画原型的时间下降，更强调尽早交付并帮工程师落地。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months, not years; speed builds trust through fast iteration and feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从过去的 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月，认为速度通过快速迭代与反馈来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他提出三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及不受旧流程束缚的“天才新人”。

jennywen.en: Put work and users at the center, not AI hype; designers control how much AI enters their craft.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心而非 AI 炒作；设计师自己掌控 AI 进入其手艺的程度。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；端到端神经网络适合自动驾驶；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems with context windows as memory; decade of agents, not year; keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是新操作系统，上下文窗口即内存；是智能体的十年而非一年；要给 AI 拴绳。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate code to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：把代码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，迭代部署有助于学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他视自动化 AI 研究为重大里程碑，并强调早期设计治理结构。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控是对齐的关键工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他指出长期对齐的核心是泛化到训练分布之外；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把泛化视为智能的核心缺口，主张用无目标的好奇心驱动探索替代强化学习对稠密奖励的依赖，并强调样本效率与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; with no internet of robot data, diverse pretraining plus real-world post-training is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026，主线一以贯之：机器人本质是数据问题。没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠视频、仿真等多样数据预训练，再用真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any embodiment; a cross-vertical data flywheel scales from structured to unstructured.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为“通用机器人大脑”愿景：像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样适配任意形态，并靠跨行业数据飞轮从结构化走向非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Deployment, not modeling, is now the primary challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年立场明显转向落地：部署本身是技术挑战而非商业问题，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，必须严格测试。

pathak.en: He stays skeptical of shortcuts: dense rewards, video-only data, and sim-to-real hidden engineering are insufficient; progress surprises even experts.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识：他始终怀疑捷径——稠密奖励、纯视频数据、仿真到现实的隐藏工程都不够；机器人进展连专家都会意外。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones, even if moral status is uncertain.
askell.zh: 即便道德地位不确定，也应善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学习。

askell.en: Model welfare and character are engineering concerns, not just philosophy: identity, security, and training data shape behavior.
askell.zh: 模型福祉与性格不只是哲学问题，也是工程问题：身份、安全感与训练数据共同塑造行为。

askell.en: The constitution works more like virtue ethics, shaping holistic character rather than enforcing rules or outcomes.
askell.zh: 宪法式训练更接近德性伦理，塑造整体性格，而非执行规则或追求结果。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should give way to judgment, but excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应让位于自主判断，但过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is essential, and AI should augment rather than disempower human expertise.
askell.zh: 公开 AI 价值观与训练目标至关重要，AI 应增强而非削弱人类专业能力。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, and vibe coding is overhyped.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 未必足够，vibe coding 被高估。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo drive clickbait; frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model will rule.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续批评 Elo 等坏基准导致标题党，并认为前沿模型因目标函数分化，不会有一家通吃。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety outranks accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年转向医疗，他指出幻觉使人类判断更关键，安全优先于准确，最大风险可能是遗漏。

edwinchen.en: A consistent thread: quality, taste and truth over hype, leaderboards and engagement optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视质量、品味与真相，反对炒作、排行榜和参与度优化。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，且现代工具已让端到端网络可解释——这与他过去对可解释性的看法相反。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; data, compute, and world models for simulation matter more than algorithmic novelty.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线一贯：自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型比算法创新更关键，他甚至称完美模拟器等于解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; camera-only reaches human level but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年持续深化：语言集成提升表征、推理与人机交互；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality beat algorithms, a lesson learned late.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，立场更鲜明：带内置传感器的大众量产车将在中短期超越 Robotaxi；他坦言重视基础设施与数据质量胜过算法是较晚才学到的教训。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers always offers a third option, making the trolley problem moot.
kendall.zh: 2026 年进一步断言：无需先验数据即可跨 500 多座城市零样本泛化；安全上最小风险 maneuvers 总提供第三种选择，电车难题只是理论练习。

turley.en: The model is the product: ship daily, learn from real-world feedback, and treat emergent properties as things only users can reveal.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：每天发布、从真实反馈中学习，涌现能力只有用户才能揭示。

turley.en: Chat is not the endgame—like MS-DOS before Windows; AI should render its own UI and embed into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终局——像 Windows 之前的 MS-DOS；AI 应自渲染界面并嵌入现有工具。

turley.en: North star shifts from accidental demo success to long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product, and model gains.
turley.zh: 北极星从偶然的 demo 成功转向长期留存，靠去摩擦、核心产品与模型进步三路驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富可供性产品；推理模型须无缝产品化。

turley.en: Safety and velocity stay separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product; AI amplifies, not replaces, humans.
turley.zh: 安全与速度始终分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发最大化加速；AI 放大而非取代人类。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, start with simpler products, and unite teams around a higher purpose to build a brand.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值：创业公司要先活下来，从更简单的产品起步证明自己，并用更高的使命把团队凝聚起来做品牌。

carlpei.en: By 2025 he reframes the phone's future around proactive, agentic AI and generative UI, while warning hardware margins are lowest and AI models will commoditize.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机的未来重新定义为主动式、智能体式的 AI 与生成式 UI，同时警告硬件利润率最低、AI 模型将商品化并陷入价格战。

carlpei.en: A consistent thread: AI is an ingredient, not a marketing label; most AI is BS, and value comes from solving real user pain points elegantly.
carlpei.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是配料而非营销标签；多数 AI 是空谈，价值来自优雅地解决用户真实痛点。

carlpei.en: Design becomes the primary differentiator in a homogeneous market, paired with marketing arbitrage and community; differentiation replaces product-market fit in mature categories.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年设计成为同质化市场中的首要差异化手段，并配合营销套利与社区；在成熟品类里差异化取代了产品市场契合。

carlpei.en: His interaction vision deepens from app-based to intent-based agents, with trust, privacy and local or hybrid compute; phones survive until brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 他的交互愿景从基于应用深化为基于意图的智能体，强调信任、隐私与本地或混合算力；手机将存续到脑机接口出现为止。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; it is on the critical path to AGI.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键，并且是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems; reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统，认为强化学习最适合低级控制，而 LLM 负责高级规划。

jimfan.en: The data bottleneck in robotics demands synthetic data from simulation and world models, scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他持续强调机器人领域的数据瓶颈，主张通过仿真和世界模型生成合成数据来扩展机器人学习。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出构建简单、端到端的机器人基础模型以利用多样数据是关键，并将物理图灵测试视为具身 AI 的宏大挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; robot GPT-3 moment in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出系统二（推理）进展良好，但系统一（低级控制）仍是具身 AI 最困难的部分，并预测机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年内到来。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题、显著提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 到 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，并认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调，智能体的进展取决于随时间推移的可靠性而非原始能力，编程是领先指标。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; progress is exponential, not plateauing, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把强化学习看作新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为进展是指数级的而非停滞，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter most; world models are not on the critical path.
sholto.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排与算力最为关键，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

nando.en: AI should augment human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video such as YouTube is a promising path to train agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 等视频中学习，是绕开昂贵强化学习来训练智能体的有前景路径。

nando.en: Main line: fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not only large models; diversity in the AI community matters.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：根本性创新可以来自任何地方，不只来自大模型；AI 社区的多元与包容至关重要。

nando.en: By 2026 his focus shifts to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenge, with solutions still open.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当今最大挑战，且坦言尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: leapfrogging legacy issues and local-language models can revolutionize education; belief is the main barrier.
nando.zh: 2026 年他主张非洲并不落后：跨越历史包袱、用本地语言模型革新教育，而最大障碍是研究者是否相信自己能进入顶尖机构。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她认为预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，且下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. She shifts from algorithmic fixes to data-centric solutions, emphasizing synthetic data and abductive reasoning.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她的思考从算法修复转向以数据为中心，强调数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识而非超越；她重视合成数据与溯因推理。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves. Open research and collaboration are crucial to compete with closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她指出强化学习需要精心设计，RLVR 可能降低 pass@k 而 best-of-n 提升；开放研究与跨机构合作对抗衡封闭前沿模型实验室至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models with high-quality diverse synthetic data can outperform larger ones; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet. RL during pre-training yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张高质量多样合成数据能使小语言模型超越大模型；多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；预训练中的强化学习带来持久推理增益。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: questioning pure scaling, advocating algorithmic and data efficiency, open research, and pluralistic alignment for safe, democratic AI.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：质疑纯 Scaling（规模扩张），倡导算法与数据效率、开放研究以及多元对齐，以实现安全、民主的 AI。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，让产品更强却不显得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions, shipping fast and iterating rather than chasing perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地强调速度为上：给设计师所有权与清晰决策，快速交付、迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not treat it as decoration.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，而非视其为装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，应尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: LLMs 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；用更多算力和数据做 Scaling 会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）来实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
